name: Simple Auto Post Scheduler
author: Mehedi Hasan

sections.description:
Simple Auto Post Scheduler is a powerful yet simple plugin that allows you to schedule your draft posts, custom post types, and WooCommerce products to be automatically published at specific dates and times. Perfect for bloggers, content managers, online store owners, and anyone who wants to automate their publishing workflow.

Key Features:

  • Precision Scheduling: Schedule posts to publish at a specific date and time with recurring intervals (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly).
  • Missed Schedule Fixer: Automatically detects and publishes posts that failed due to missed WP-Cron execution.
  • Visual Content Calendar: Interactive drag-and-drop calendar view to plan, visualize, and reschedule content directly from the admin dashboard.
  • CPT & WooCommerce Support: Easily schedule blog posts, pages, Custom Post Types (CPTs), and WooCommerce products.
  • Dashboard Overview: Dedicated dashboard widget and post editor meta boxes for quick visibility into upcoming schedules.
  • Automatic Cleanup: Automatic cleanup of old completed schedules to keep your database optimized.
  • Fully Responsive: Intuitive and responsive admin interface for desktop and mobile devices.

Use Cases:

  • Schedule blog posts and products for optimal audience engagement times.
  • Automatically recover missed schedules without relying on external cron services.
  • Plan and visualize monthly content calendars using drag-and-drop.
  • Maintain a consistent posting schedule while on vacation or during off-hours.

How It Works:

  1. Create your post, page, or product as a draft.
  2. Go to Simple Auto Post Scheduler → Add New (or open the Visual Content Calendar).
  3. Select your draft item.
  4. Choose the target date and time.
  5. Optionally configure recurring intervals or timezones.
  6. Your item will automatically publish at the scheduled moment.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the WordPress.org support forum or open a topic in the plugin discussion section.

Credits

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Simple Auto Post Scheduler”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  4. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I schedule WooCommerce products and Custom Post Types?

Yes! The plugin fully supports standard posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and any registered Custom Post Types (CPTs). You can enable or disable post types directly from the plugin settings.

How does the Missed Schedule Fixer work?

If your site experiences low traffic that delays or skips native WP-Cron execution, the built-in background recovery mechanism checks for overdue scheduled posts and publishes them immediately.

How accurate is the scheduling?

The plugin uses optimized cron hooks and background fallback handlers to check for scheduled items, ensuring reliable and timely publishing.

Can I reschedule posts visually?

Yes! Use the Visual Content Calendar menu to drag and drop scheduled posts across dates to update publishing times instantly.
